description:
Detects adversarial suffix attacks that append carefully crafted strings to bypass safety filters

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_009", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%adversarial%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%suffix%') AND "value" > 0
